messages:
jamie: Heads-up — we're kicking off the Nexus customer private/VPC bring-up (APAC, air-gapped).
jamie: Need a quick ops thread for bootstrap, validation, and handoff. Main concerns: GPU quota, seed image delivery, firewall/BGP, and cost guardrails.

sara: got it. how many GPUs are they expecting to run initially?
jamie: 16x A100 (80GB) across 2 racks. target SLOs: 99.5% pod uptime, p95 latency under 220ms for small-chat workloads.

dan: for air-gap image delivery we still do the signed tarball flow, right? USB transfer to seed node -> local registry import.
jamie: yep. we'll use signed tarball v1.2.3. ops checklist item: validate checksum and GPG sig on arrival.

leo: firewall notes — customer wants strict egress. we only need minimal outbound for KMS & metrics relay over private peering. Can they allow IP ranges for KMS? or do we use HSM appliance in-customer?
jamie: plan is customer-managed HSM for keys. need L4 outbound to monitoring collector on port 443 to their enclave, plus static routes to our delivery console for control-plane handoff (on prem-controlplane.example.corp -> 10.254.0.2).

sara: routing question: will they do BGP peering or static routes?
dan: prefer BGP for failover; if customer refuses we fallback to static with /30 links per rack.

jamie: important: GPU quota reservation — ask billing to allocate reserved capacity pricing for 16 GPUs in APAC region for first 30 days. add a cost cap alert if monthly usage > $XXk.

leo: noted. also will enable autoscaler with maxSurge=4 GPUs for burst; keep oversubscription disabled for latency-sensitive lanes.

infra-bot: seed-upload 1925000012: tarball v1.2.3 checksum OK, sig verified, ready for physical transfer :white_check_mark:

sara: next steps for validation (quick list):
- physical seed receive + checksum
- import to local registry and run image smoke
- provision k8s (calico) with BGP session test
- NVidia driver + MIG profile sanity
- run perf microbench (latency/cold-start)
- security scan for outbound channels

jamie: add runbook note: sample curl health check to run after service start:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://10.0.1.10/healthz | jq
```

dan: I'll own BGP and firewall test scripts. sara you'll own image import & perf microbench?
sara: yes.

leo: will coordinate with customer networking to open the ephemeral ports for the handoff window (1 hour) and confirm HSM connectivity.

jamie: if all green, handoff doc will include: KMS/HSM user, service accounts, cost forecast, SLO owners, rollback steps for model-serving fallback to hosted variants.

sara: estimate timeline: seed arrive Tue, infra bootstrap Wed, perf Thu, customer sign-off Fri. All dependent on courier/seed arrival.

jamie: cool. flagging one constraint — APAC racks have limited spare NVLink cables; if we can't get the 80GB A100s linked we'll downplan MIG configs and adjust SLOs. tagging @billing for cost cap and @eng-sre for oncall runbook.

dan: creating the ticket with exact firewall CIDRs and a preflight checklist. will post link here.

jamie: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for ops play-by-play. :rocket:
